description: Business plans: ordered steps, each alerting contacts and whoever is on call in schedules, then waiting for an acknowledgement before the next. Monitors use it with update_monitor's escalation_policy_id. Free.

repeat_count.description: Times the whole policy runs again when nobody acknowledges.

steps.description: In order; sending steps replaces them all. Each names contacts, schedules or both.

schedule_ids.description: On-call schedules whose on-call contact it alerts.

wait_minutes.description: Minutes to wait for an acknowledgement before the next step.

name: create_escalation_policy
title: Create an escalation policy
